marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:
Wind light tonight and Friday. Showers or flurries becoming flurries near midnight then
snow overnight. Rain Friday morning and ending near noon Friday. Fog patches
forming Friday afternoon. Low tonight minus 2. High Friday plus 3. <br/>
